name: neurofibromin 1

function.text: NF1 encodes neurofibromin, a RAS GTPase-activating protein that promotes conversion of active RAS-GTP to inactive RAS-GDP and restrains RAS signaling.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to neurofibromatosis type 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations are described across multiple tumor groups, including Mucosal melanoma; Pheochromocytoma; Cutaneous melanoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: NF1 encodes neurofibromin, a RAS GTPase-activating protein that promotes conversion of active RAS-GTP to inactive RAS-GDP and restrains RAS signaling.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with neurofibromatosis type 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NF1 have been reported in malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor, glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype, and glioblastoma.
